scripts.build: bun run build:contracts && bun run build:web
scripts.build:contracts: bun run --cwd packages/contracts build && bun run --cwd packages/contracts sync:abi
scripts.test: bun run test:contracts && bun run test:web && bun run test:production
scripts.test:flap: bun run --cwd packages/contracts test:flap && bun run --cwd apps/web test
scripts.check: bun run build && bun run test && bun run audit:web-performance && bun run audit:dependencies && bun run audit:contracts
scripts.deploy:prepare: bun run --cwd packages/contracts build && bun scripts/launch/prepare.ts && bun scripts/launch/verify.ts
scripts.test:launch:fork: bun run --cwd packages/contracts build && bun scripts/launch/rehearse.ts
scripts.clean: rm -rf .nuxt .output out cache broadcast node_modules/.cache/nuxt apps/web/.nuxt apps/web/.output apps/web/dist apps/web/.data apps/web/node_modules/.cache/nuxt packages/contracts/out packages/contracts/cache packages/contracts/broadcast
